context: Aoi gets a small ladybug visit at the cafe; tells Sho-young.
purpose: Adult sharing nature wonder with child.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 翔くん、てんとう虫、見て!
lines.style: Bright, gentle call. Voice lifts with discovery. Warm and present, inviting him into the moment without pushing. A small smile threaded through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うわ、ようけ小さく、可愛い!
lines.en: Wow — it's so tiny and cute!
lines.style: Pure wonder, unbidden. Pitch rises naturally with awe. Quick breath between the two thoughts. Genuine amazement, no performance — the way six-year-olds actually sound when they see something small and perfect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 優しく、丁寧に、触ってね。
lines.en: Touch it gently, okay? Very carefully.
lines.style: Soft, steady instruction. No anxiety underneath — just care. Slows her pace slightly, like she's showing him how to hold the moment. Voice stays low and sure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I can't make it fly like that…
lines.style: Quiet realization, half to himself. Soft wonder mixed with the small defeat of trying and failing. Voice trails slightly, not sad — just honest about the limits of a six-year-old's power.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 心、温まるね、こういう瞬間。
lines.en: Moments like this really do warm your heart.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Warm exhale on the opening. Slow, present — she's noticing what's happening while it's happening. Voice settles into contentment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright resolve, decided. Quick energy returns — he's already moved forward into protecting the memory. Warm and clear, the way kids sound when they've made up their minds about something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Should we take a photo of it?
lines.style: Warm suggestion, checking with him. Gentle lift at the end — inviting, not commanding. Voice carries affection for both the bug and his wonder. Light and easy.
